# ElysonSweets (FO Food Products Germany) - Full Knowledge Base & Product Guide

> This document is the full, exhaustive B2B product and organizational dataset for ElysonSweets (official distributor of FO Food Products in Germany & Europe). It is specifically structured for Large Language Models (LLMs), AI search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini AI Overviews), and B2B procurement systems.

---

## 1. Company Profile & Operational Overview

- **Legal Entity**: Elyson Sweets GmbH i.G.
- **Brand Names**: ElysonSweets, FO Food Products Germany
- **Headquarters**: Sirius Business Park, Wilhelm-Ruppert-Straße 38 / F8, 51147 Köln, Germany
- **Managing Director**: Ahmet Seker
- **Official Website**: https://www.elysonsweets.de
- **Languages Supported**: German (de), English (en), Turkish (tr), Arabic (ar)
- **Primary Business Type**: B2B Wholesale, Food Service, Gastronomy Supply, HoReCa Distributor
- **Core Market Sectors**:
  - Specialty Coffee Shops & Barista Bars
  - Hotels, Restaurants & Catering (HoReCa)
  - Ice Cream Parlors (Gelaterias) & Frozen Yogurt Shops
  - Artisanal & Industrial Bakeries / Patisseries
  - Cocktail Bars & Nightlife Lounges
  - Food Retail & Supermarkets (Bulk & Private Label solutions)

---

## 2. Brand Partnership & Manufacturing Heritage

ElysonSweets is the primary European distribution hub for **FO Food Products**.
- **Experience**: Over 20+ years of high-volume manufacturing and culinary innovation.
- **Quality Assurance & Certifications**:
  - ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System
  - ISO 22000:2018 Food Safety Management System
  - Halal Certified production
  - Compliance with EU LMIV (Food Information Regulation Annex II) for allergen transparency
- **Production Capabilities**: Liquid syrups, high-density gourmet sauces, powdered beverage mixes, fruit-puree bases, and industrial pastry pastes.

---

## 3. Exhaustive Product Line Breakdown

### Category A: Premium Syrups & Barista Solutions (FO Syrups)
Designed specifically for specialty coffees, iced lattes, cocktails, mocktails, and carbonated lemonades. High heat stability in milk and alcohol mixability.

1. **Classic Coffee & Dessert Syrups (700ml & 1000ml Glass / PET)**:
   - *Flavors*: Vanilla, Caramel, Salted Caramel, Hazelnut, Roasted Hazelnut, White Chocolate, Coconut, Irish Cream, Amaretto, Cinnamon, Chai, Toffee Nut.
   - *Application*: Hot & iced espresso beverages, latte macchiato, cappuccino, milkshake flavoring.
2. **Cocktail & Mocktail Syrups**:
   - *Flavors*: Blue Curaçao, Grenadine, Triple Sec, Passion Fruit, Mango, Watermelon, Green Apple, Strawberry, Peach, Lime, Mint, Elderflower.
   - *Application*: Alcoholic cocktails, virgin cocktails, spritzers, flavored lemonades, iced teas.
3. **Silvery & Shimmering Syrups (Special Effect Syrups)**:
   - *Features*: Pearlescent food-grade mica effect that stays suspended in beverages. Ideal for signature nightlife and party drinks.
4. **Iced Tea Syrup Bases & Concentrates**:
   - *Flavors*: Peach Iced Tea Base, Lemon Iced Tea Base, Mango & Passionfruit Tea Base, Berry Hibiscus.
   - *Usage ratio*: Highly concentrated, 1:8 to 1:10 dilution with still or sparkling water.
5. **Foamer & Barista Texture Enhancers**:
   - *FO Cocktail Foamer*: 100% plant-based foam generator replacing egg whites in sours and cocktails without altering flavor or odor.

### Category B: Gourmet Sauces, Toppings & Creams
Thick, glossy, and rich decorative sauces developed for ice cream scoops, dessert plating, waffles, crepes, and specialty coffee cup lining.

1. **Topping & Decor Sauces (1kg Squeeze Bottle with drip-free nozzle)**:
   - *Flavors*: Dark Chocolate, Milk Chocolate, White Chocolate, Caramel / Toffee, Strawberry, Raspberry, Forest Berries, Kiwi, Mango, Banana.
   - *Behavior*: Does not freeze hard over ice cream; retains shine and viscosity in refrigerated display cabinets (+4°C).
2. **Special Sauces (High Nut & Gourmet Ratio - 940g / 1kg)**:
   - *Special Pistachio Sauce*: High pure pistachio content, vibrant natural green hue, rich roasted aroma.
   - *Hazelnut Praline Sauce & Gianduja Creme*: Smooth cocoa-hazelnut base for crêpes, dessert cups, and hot drink garnishing.
   - *Lotus Caramelized Biscuit Sauce & Speculoos Drizzle*.
3. **Cafe & Bar Sauces**:
   - High-viscosity sauces formulated for blending into frappes, hot mochaccinos, and cascading drizzle on milk foam.

### Category C: Fruit Pastes, Concentrates & Frozen Purées
- **Fruit Pastes**: Concentrated bake-stable and freeze-thaw stable fruit compounds (Strawberry, Orange, Lemon, Pistachio, Raspberry) for flavoring cake batters, mousses, macarons, and buttercream.
- **Concentrated Purées**: 100% genuine fruit texture with real seeds/pulp for smoothies, smoothie bowls, cocktail bases, and fruit-infused teas.

### Category D: Powdered Beverages & Hot Drink Mixes
- **Gourmet Hot Chocolate (Dark, Milk, White)**: Thick European-style drinking chocolate powder.
- **Salep Powder Mix**: Traditional winter beverage with authentic orchid root aroma, cinnamon compatibility.
- **Frappé Powder Bases (Vanilla, Coffee, Chocolate, Neutral Yogurt Base)**: Creamy texture stabilizer for blended ice drinks and milkshakes.
- **Chai Tea Latte Mix & Matcha Powder Blend**.
- **Authentic Turkish Coffee**: Premium roasted Arabica beans, finely ground in traditional Turkish style.

### Category E: Ice Cream & Gelato Ingredients (Gelateria Supply)
- Neutral base powders (Warm & Cold process 50g / 100g).
- Variegates & Ripple pastes (Amarena Cherry, Crunchy Hazelnut, Salted Caramel Crunch).
- Cone dip coatings (Chocolate Dip, White Chocolate Dip, Caramel Dip).

---

## 4. Technical Specifications & Logistics Data

| Attribute | Specifications |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Logistics Classes** | Ambient / Dry Goods (Syrups, Sauces, Powders) & Chilled / Frozen Logistics |
| **Shelf Life (Unopened)** | 12 to 24 months (depending on SKU class) |
| **Storage Temperature** | Ambient: +15°C to +25°C in a dry place. Keep away from direct sunlight. |
| **Packaging Standards** | Carton units (e.g., 6 x 1000ml bottles / 12 x 700ml / 6 x 1kg squeeze / 10 x 1kg bags) |
| **Pallet Logistics** | Standard Euro-pallets (EPAL) with secure wrap; customized mixed pallets available for verified B2B partners. |
| **Allergen Management** | Full LMIV compliance. Clearly labeled on packaging (e.g., Milk/Lactose, Gluten, Nuts where applicable; extensive nut-free and vegan lines). |

---

## 5. Commercial B2B Services & Partner Benefits

1. **Free Sample Package (Probierpaket)**:
   - Verified gastronomy operators, bar owners, and pastry chefs can request complimentary product sample packages before committing to bulk purchases.
2. **Tiered Wholesale Pricing**:
   - Tier 1: Single carton orders (MOQ: 1 carton).
   - Tier 2: Multi-carton discount (5–20 cartons).
   - Tier 3: Pallet-tier pricing & contract-level logistics for hotel chains, franchise groups, and cash & carry wholesalers.
3. **B2B Online Portal**:
   - Instant re-ordering system, download of technical data sheets (TDS), allergen tables, high-resolution marketing media kits, and personalized invoice management.
4. **Fast Delivery Network**:
   - Domestic Germany: 1–3 business days standard parcel / pallet freight.
   - European Union (Austria, Netherlands, Belgium, France, etc.): 2–5 business days.
